services.name: Book Charter
services.desc: On our full day charters, we will fish from 20-40 miles offshore. On these trips we are looking for King mackerel, Mahi-Mahi, Cobia, and the occasional sailfish! When we stop to bottom fish, our target species include grouper, red snapper, vermillion, snapper, grunts, and porgies. We recommend these trips to the avid angler who are looking to fill their coolers while exploring what the coast of North Carolina has to

includes: Fishing license covered under blanket licenses for the boat
Fishing rods and tackle provided; guests may bring their own rods with prior notice
blurb: Guests fish offshore and nearshore for species like king mackerel, mahi-mahi, cobia, Spanish mackerel, and more. Trips range from nearshore family-friendly outings to full-day offshore charters targeting a variety of fish. The vessel is a 33-foot World Cat Tournament Express providing a smooth, stable ride with amenities including a bathroom.
extraNote: 14-day cancellation notice for deposit refund less 4% fee · Cancellations within 48 hours subject to 50% trip cost charge · Full refund of security deposit if weather prevents fishing and trip cannot be rescheduled
